notes: Neutral international Spanish (no regionalisms, no vosotros). Address the user informally as "tú" (imperatives like "Vuelve a intentarlo", possessive "tu"). Sentence case for all labels, titles and headings (only the first word and proper nouns capitalised, e.g. "Nuevo Testamento" stays capitalised). Curly double quotes “ ” for quoted UI names. Error toasts written "X — try again" become two sentences: "No se pudo … . Vuelve a intentarlo" (no final period where the English has none); avoid the English spaced dash. Prefer LatAm-neutral vocabulary understood everywhere: "agregar" (not "añadir"), "costo", "ejemplar" for a printed copy, "subir" for upload, "grapar" for staple, "a doble cara" / "voltear por el borde largo/corto" for duplex. "Disposición" for layout (never "diseño", which is reserved for a design). Lulu's English-only option names stay in English. Decimal comma ("0,4 in") and a space before % ("100 %").
